verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents outbound webhooks. You can set up a webhook of type `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED` and read screening results from its payload. Each delivery carries a `webhook-id` header for idempotency, and per-account webhook signing is available as an opt-in. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of event types beyond WORKFLOW_COMPLETED, explicit registration/management steps (API or UI), retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
